summary: Selects one CHOP input by index, optionally using the first input as the index source for signal-driven switching.

key_params.name: indexfirst
key_params.note: Use the first input as the index signal

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Input index when not using first-input indexing

key_params.name: extend
key_params.note: Clamp, loop, or zigzag out-of-range indexes

key_concepts: Switch CHOP controls CHOPnet flow by selecting exactly one input CHOP by index and copying it unchanged.
When First Input is Index is enabled, the first input becomes the switch control and the remaining inputs become selectable choices.
The switch index is read from the first channel at the current frame and fractional indices are rounded down to an integer.
Use Cross CHOP or Blend CHOP when the network should blend between inputs instead of hard-switching.
common_gotchas: Fractional index values are floored to integers.
Out-of-range indexes clamp unless Extend is set to loop or zigzag.
When Index First Input is enabled, the first wired CHOP is control data, not a selectable source.
